subject: FY25 Upfront: cadence and evidence rotation for regional VAT grouping
messages:

Date: 2025-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: FY25 prepay cadence question

Hi Kimberly,

We want to finalize the upfront prepay cadence for FY25 and make sure our finance team has the documentation they need for VAT compliance across our EU/US entities. Can you confirm the invoicing cadence you recommend for a $1.2M annual commitment, and whether Redwood can provide staggered invoices (quarterly invoices with monthly drawdowns) vs one large annual invoice? Also need to confirm what VAT evidence you require from us to release staged drawdowns to your ledger.

Our billing contact is cc'd (billing@ubiqcorp.com) — they'd prefer minimal monthly paperwork.

Thanks,
Carla Ruiz
Head of Finance, UbiqCorp
[Attachment: Forecast_Q3-Q4_2025.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Carla Ruiz <carla@ubiqcorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FY25 prepay cadence question

Carla — thanks for the note. Happy to lay out an ops-friendly approach. In short: we support both structures, but for predictability and accounting simplicity we usually recommend one invoice per quarter tied to drawdown windows, with the following pattern:

- Invoice cadence: Quarterly (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) with each invoice covering a projected three-month usage tranche.
- Drawdown cadence: Weekly internal withdrawals from that tranche (automated by us) — aggregated on the monthly statement for your AP team.
- Alternate: One annual invoice is fine if your treasury prefers it; we can amortize on our side and provide monthly usage statements.

VAT evidence: minimal set we require per EU regs — VAT-registered entity ID + local billing entity PDF or a VAT-exempt certificate where applicable. I attached our VAT evidence checklist and a sample invoice template for the format your AP team can expect.

I've cc'd Jordan to confirm the billing/ledger flow and Marissa for CS visibility on usage reporting.

Attachments: FY25_PrePay_Invoice_Sample.pdf, VAT_Evidence_Checklist.xlsx

Next steps: If quarterly works, I'll issue the first invoice for the Jul-Sep tranche and include DocuSign for signature + a HubSpot deal reference for your PO. If you'd rather a single annual invoice, tell me and I'll flip the schedule.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FY25_PrePay_Invoice_Sample.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks Kimberly — couple of clarifying items from our AP team:

1) For the quarterly invoice + weekly drawdown model: will each weekly drawdown show as a separate line on our monthly statement or will it be summarized? Our SAP ingestion prefers a single monthly line per ledger account.
2) Do you provide an amortization schedule we can upload to our AR system to reflect the prepay being burned monthly?
3) For VAT evidence: will Redwood accept a single consolidated VAT pack each quarter, or do you need evidence per drawdown?

If you can answer those, we can route the PO and get the SOW signed. Also — do you need bank remittance details upfront or only at invoice time?

—UbiqCorp Billing Team

Hi — answers inline below.

1) Monthly statement: We will summarize internal weekly drawdowns into a single "Monthly Consumption" line on your monthly statement (CSV + PDF) to make SAP ingestion straightforward. If you'd prefer weekly lines we can provide them as a supplementary CSV.

2) Amortization schedule: Yes — we will produce a machine-readable amortization CSV that maps invoice tranches to monthly consumption records for your AR team to import. I'll attach a sample in the DocuSign package.

3) VAT evidence: a consolidated VAT pack per quarter is acceptable as long as it includes entity IDs and scanned VAT registration docs for each billing entity. We only require per-drawdown evidence in edge cases (cross-border re-invoicing).

Bank remit: please provide the PO and we will send the initial invoice; bank details appear on the invoice PDF. If your treasury requires our SWIFT/IBAN earlier, we can share a secure bank remit sheet via the link below.

Proposed timeline if you agree to quarterly invoicing:
- 2025-08-25: Redwood sends Q3 (Jul-Sep) invoice (DocuSign envelope + FY25 invoice PDF)
- 2025-08-27: UbiqCorp countersigns SOW / returns PO
- 2025-09-01: First monthly consumption statement generated for Aug (covering first weekly drawdowns)

I attached the VAT Evidence Checklist and added the HubSpot deal link for your PO reference. Jordan will own the ledger posting cadence; Marissa will ensure the monthly usage export meets your SAP schema.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4837  |  DocuSign (invoice envelope)

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
